title: GLM native search recurrence exposes lost server-tool observations and replay-contract ambiguity
wanted_capability: Explain and correctly handle GLM native search protocol blocks during ordinary code tasks. Preserve actual server executions in durable observations and replay provider-owned blocks without fabricating client results. Determine placeholder invocation cause from request/response evidence before selecting a repair; a tool deny list is not a protocol fix.
fallback_used: Inspected transport snapshots because durable event logs omit the server-tool blocks. Root withdrew the filter-only explanation and dispatched protocol investigation.

notes: Confirmed replay and durable-observation defects are repaired in commits 624c8603 and 8c01614d; native input_schema is limited to the MiniMax protocol variation. Full workspace verification at e7985322 passed 6684 tests. Canonical and GLM server blocks have replay and log regressions. The cause of placeholder search initiation remains unproven; neither a query deny list nor capability disablement is the repair. Fresh provider probes on 2026-09-06 at 20:49:11 UTC (glm-5.3) and 20:57:24 UTC (glm-5.3-flash) returned HTTP 429 code 1308, explicitly a five-hour quota cap. The reset timestamp did not carry a timezone. Follow-up at 2026-09-06T21:46:50Z again directly observed Flash HTTP429/code1308. Native-search scrutiny found and reproduced lost tool_search activation on process resume; this is correlated with both saved incidents, but provider query-selection causality remains unproven. No query deny list or default search disablement was added. Live allocator preview separately attributed no_candidates to an expired runtime-rate-limit exclusion. Final follow-up deployed b015e051; native activation recovery and runtime cooldown expiry gaps are addressed. Normal Flash bro_exec now passes allocation and reaches the provider. Its terminal event at 2026-09-06T22:14:50.299Z contains a fresh HTTP429/code1308 five-hour quota cap, and a new active cooldown was recorded. Successful provider experiment on 2026-10-06T00:23Z (harness a6053430, glm-5.3-flash, scripts/probe-glm-native-search.py --live, cases all, 6 harness processes, 14 upstream requests, all HTTP 200, no 1308): status pass. Native search started only in the two cases that asked for it (5 server_tool_use starts, 5 paired results, 0 unmatched), every query a real one for the task; the 8 requests of the arithmetic, report and resume-without-search cases produced no native start at all with native search enabled, so the placeholder initiation did not recur in this run. Resume after search answered from the replayed conversation without a new search; resume with a new search ran and paired normally; tool_search activation survived every process resume. One observation, contained: in one fresh-search response the model emitted tool_search twice with identical input in one batch (the duplicate client emission the containment probe covers); the run still passed. Placeholder causality stays unproven for lack of a recurrence, not for lack of a working provider; the two saved incidents remain the only evidence.
